headline: CHC @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 4.70 at CHW 3.77, with a projected total of 8.47. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHW: CHC moved -0.65 runs while CHW moved +0.41, changing the projected margin by -1.06 runs. NRFI probability rose +11.7%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Erick Fedde has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Miguel Vargas, Colson Montgomery, Alex Bregman, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Matt Shaw, Moisés Ballesteros because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
